dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I'd been born in a romantic, noble time like that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What time?

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: Hmph... What other time could I mean? The romantic time of His Majesty the Belyi Tsar, naturally.

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: I, Eteri Vsevolodovna Strivozha, descendant of Saint Strivozha, the Pure One, am duty-bound to remember that ancient glory!

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: Snezhnaya was nothing like this back then... not dull and lifeless like it is now.

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: A messenger of His Majesty the Belyi Tsar crossed whole continents, even the land of the Nether, all to meet the witch from the east who stole his heart at first sight...

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: The Prinzessin der Verurteilung shattered the divine halberd forged by His Majesty himself, all for some nameless thief who had stolen a national treasure...

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: And a knight from the kingdom at the heart of the earth went to face an evil dragon alone, just to win a smile from a golden-haired outlander...

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: ...Ah, even the cold winds over the ice fields must have carried the fragrance of roses and the grace of proper etiquette! What an enchanting time that must have been...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: Hmph... Very well. I shall not keep you. But please do remember the honor you were granted today, speaking with a descendant of Saint Strivozha.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I feel like I've heard that before...

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: Um-hum. Then you must have. Stories this noble and romantic would surely have reached your ears as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't that all from light novels? Pirated ones, too, if I remember right...

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: W-What!? Please mind your words!

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: These are noble memories passed down through the blood of us Vila... I mean, I never saw any of it myself, but that is how it happened in the opera Lady Vesna took me to see!

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: Naturally, I have no real interest in that sort of commoner entertainment. Lady Vesna was simply kind enough to invite me, so I reluctantly agreed to watch their rather crude performance...

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: I-In any case! These are matters of serious history! If you continue to tarnish my good name like this, then I shall... I shall be forced to request a duel!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Eteri
dialogues.text: Hmph... Very well. I shall not keep you. But please do remember the honor you were granted today, speaking with a descendant of Saint Strivozha.
